_doc: V1 regex freeze for definition-sentence parsers (Mahmood, 13 Oct, ruling 6). A frozen file may change only by appending a failure class below that names the plant test which failed first and the file's new git blob id. Uncertain definition sentences are not parsed harder: they abstain (harness/target_endpoint._resolve_reference -> BINDING_NONE / ENDPOINT_UNBOUND, candidates listed) and enforcement refuses an unbound row unless a signed human decision admits it. tests/test_regex_freeze.py enforces this.

decision.words: sign and do as you suggested for all
decision.item: MORNING_SUMMARY_2026-10-13 item 6: consistent with the V1 freeze, no rewrite for V1; freeze the regex parsers; log every new failure class with a plant; route uncertain definition sentences to unresolved, then human adjudication; the typed / recorded reader is the first post-V1 item

pending_freeze.scripts/m2_pretriage.py: the pre-triage number reader (branch m2/pretriage-2026-10-13, not on main); it joins `frozen` in the PR that lands it

post_v1.item: typed / recorded reader for definition sentences, replacing the frozen regex parsers
